evidence: frontend/apps/reality-web/src/app/[locale]/price-map/page.tsx — the price-map page declares useTranslations('pages.priceMap') but only ever calls t() for the single h1 (t('h1') at :138). Effectively every other user-facing string on this public, 4-locale (sk/cs/de/en) page is a hardcoded Slovak literal that bypasses next-intl, so cs/de/en visitors see Slovak. Occurrences: PROPERTY_OPTIONS labels :30-34 'Všetky'/'Byty'/'Domy'/'Pozemky'; transaction toggle :161 'Predaj'/'Prenájom'; map loading :209 'Načítavam dáta…'; map error :213 'Dáta o cenách sa nepodarilo načítať.'; no-geometry empty state :224 'Pre vybrané lokality zatiaľ nie je dostupný mapový podklad. Štatistiky nájdete v zozname vpravo.'; SVG aria-label :231 'Mapa cien podľa lokality'; legend :272 'Cena / m²' and :275-278 range labels; back link :322 '← Späť na prehľad'; detail rows :337-348 'Priem. cena / m²'/'Trend (medzikvartálne)'/'Aktívne inzeráty'; CTA :392 'Zobraziť inzeráty v tejto lokalite'; right-panel :405 'Prehľad lokalít', :414 'Kliknite na lokalitu pre detailné štatistiky.', :426 'Pre zvolené filtre nie sú dostupné žiadne dáta.'; insights labels :77/:82/:87/:95 'Priemerná cena / m²'/'Najdrahšia lokalita'/'Najväčší rast'/'Aktívne inzeráty' and trend suffixes :79/:97 'lokalít', :91 '% QoQ'.

The page's own data-i18n="pages.price-map.root" marker (:106) and its use of the pages.priceMap namespace for the h1 show localization was intended but left unfinished. Landable frontend-only remedy: move each literal into the messages/{en,sk,cs,de}.json catalogs under pages.priceMap and wrap with t() (using t.rich / interpolation for the trend + count suffixes). Verifiable in cloud via pnpm --filter @ppt/reality-web typecheck/test.

frontend/apps/reality-web/src/app/[locale]/auth/callback/page.tsx — the SSO callback screen localizes its error/title/return-home copy via useTranslations('auth.callback') (:132-135), but the two loading messages shown during the (common) success path are hardcoded English: :67 'Loading...' in LoadingSpinner and :146 'Completing login...' in SsoCallbackContent. On a 4-locale (sk/cs/de/en) portal, sk/cs/de users completing SSO see English strings on the auth flow.

Landable frontend-only remedy: add auth.callback.loading / auth.callback.completing keys to messages/{en,sk,cs,de}.json and replace the two literals with t() (LoadingSpinner would need the translations passed in or its own hook). Low severity — transient state, no functional break. Verifiable via pnpm --filter @ppt/reality-web typecheck.

frontend/apps/reality-web/src/app/[locale]/journal/page.tsx:96 — ArticleCard renders reading time as `{article.author} · {article.readMin} min čítania`, a hardcoded Slovak suffix, while the same page's Most-Read sidebar correctly renders the identical concept via t('readingTime', { min: article.readMin }) at :327. The inconsistency proves the card should reuse the existing pages.journal.readingTime catalog entry; as written, cs/de/en journal readers see 'min čítania' on every article card.

Landable frontend-only remedy: replace the inline suffix with the existing t('readingTime', { min: article.readMin }) (ArticleCard already renders within the JournalPage tree; pass t down or call useTranslations in ArticleCard). Low severity, single string, but a concrete i18n regression against the page's own established pattern.
